灵感搭子。适合交换思路，轮流当彼此的小老师。少一点说教，多一点好奇，问问对方的理: Learning from each other. Swap ideas and take turns learning from each other. Stay curious, ask why, and leave room for discoveries without turning the conversation into a lecture.
